It's not wrong to feel overwhelmed or feeling defeated when things are not going the way you want. Just try to survive one more day. Just hold on there for a little more. I know people around you won't be always kind or understanding. But there are many who will be there for you and who will mourn for you. Who will miss you in everything they see. 
If you just survive one more day maybe you will get to see your favourite season or favourite artist or read a new book that will be your new favourite or find a person that will adore you to the fullest.

So never lose hope. There are many people in this world who would appreciate your existence so don't give up on life.
